1. IDENTIFICATION OF THE SUBSTANCE/PREPARATION & THE COMPANY/UNDERTAKING 
Product Name 
Coriander Seed Oil Organic 
Biological Definition 
The volatile oil obtained from steam distillation of the nearly ripe fruits of the herb 
Coriandrum sativum L. (Fam. Apiaceae). 
INCI Name 
Coriandrum sativum se
